title: wangxijie001/yoji
claim: wangxijie001/yoji — 有情绪的 AI 桌面伴侣 | 隐私优先 · 语音唤醒 · 协助办公 · MCP 无限扩展 | An AI desktop companion with emotions — privacy-first, voice wake, office
why_good: Yoji is an open-source desktop AI companion that runs fully locally, with voice wake, file management, script execution, web search, MCP tool integration, a hormone-based emotion system, and a Live2D avatar. It uniquely combines a local sub-agent factory with async task scheduling, all without cloud dependency.
value: Privacy-conscious professionals and hobbyists pay for a one-time license or Patreon support to get a local AI that manages files and runs scripts without cloud uploads.
risk: The incumbent is the cloud AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude) that users already pay for; if they add local mode, Yoji's edge evaporates.

zh.claim: 有情绪的 AI 桌面伴侣，隐私优先，语音唤醒，能操作电脑，MCP 无限扩展。
zh.hook: 独立开发者和高级用户想要一个真正本地、隐私优先、能操作电脑的 AI 助手，但要么被困在云端依赖的代理中，要么只能使用需要技术设置的命令行工具。
zh.does: Yoji 是一个开源桌面 AI 伴侣，完全本地运行，具备语音唤醒、文件管理、脚本执行、联网搜索、MCP 工具集成、基于激素的情绪系统和 Live2D 虚拟形象。它独特地结合了本地子 Agent 工厂和异步任务调度，且不依赖云端。
zh.why_use: 用户抱怨无法看到 AI 在做什么或调用了哪些工具，而 Yoji 通过透明的工具调用和本地优先设计解决了这个问题。它还提供了完整的包：情绪、记忆和可扩展性，全部集成在一个应用中。
zh.gap: 只有极客才能使用：它需要 pnpm 11，手动安装，语音功能目前仅支持 macOS，没有围绕它打造一个面向普通用户的产品。
zh.counter: 这是一个功能，而不是一个公司：OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 桌面应用或微软的 Copilot 只需一次更新就能添加本地文件访问和语音唤醒，而且他们已经拥有用户的信任和分发渠道。
zh.differentiator: 将 Yoji 打包成 Windows 和 macOS 的一键安装程序，并提供引导式设置，面向不想处理命令行的非技术用户，提供私有 AI。
zh.value: 注重隐私的专业人士和爱好者支付一次性许可费或 Patreon 支持，以获得一个能在不上传云端的情况下管理文件和运行脚本的本地 AI。
zh.risk: 现有竞争对手是用户已经在付费的云 AI 助手（ChatGPT、Claude）；如果他们添加本地模式，Yoji 的优势就会消失。
zh.why_good: Yoji 是一个开源桌面 AI 伴侣，完全本地运行，具备语音唤醒、文件管理、脚本执行、联网搜索、MCP 工具集成、基于激素的情绪系统和 Live2D 虚拟形象。它独特地结合了本地子 Agent 工厂和异步任务调度，且不依赖云端。

does: Yoji is an open-source desktop AI companion that runs fully locally, with voice wake, file management, script execution, web search, MCP tool integration, a hormone-based emotion system, and a Live2D avatar. It uniquely combines a local sub-agent factory with async task scheduling, all without cloud dependency.
edge: Yoji's unique emotional engine simulates real emotions, affecting its responses and behavior, creating a more engaging user experience.
why_use: Users complain about not being able to see what the AI is doing or which tools it calls, and Yoji addresses this with transparent tool calls and a local-first design. It also offers a complete package: emotion, memory, and extensibility, all in one app.
hook: Solo developers and power users who want a truly local, privacy-first AI assistant that can actually operate their computer are stuck with either cloud-dependent agents or bare CLI tools that require technical setup.

gap: No verified demand; the project is fresh and lacks user evidence, though the local AI companion space is crowded.
counter: This is a feature, not a company: OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app or Microsoft's Copilot could add local file access and voice wake with one update, and they already own the user's trust and distribution.
differentiator: Package Yoji as a one-click installer for Windows and macOS with a guided setup, targeting non-technical users who want a private AI but can't handle the CLI.
consumer_angle: An ordinary-person AI desktop companion that runs locally, but the gap is not clear yet.
pick_reason: Fresh repo with no first-hand demand evidence; the gap and wedge are not yet concrete.
